objective: Confirm the future Ascend-C candidate is self-contained and free of CUDA texture/runtime dependencies and external side effects.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and build files; read their dependencies and side-effect sites.
pass_condition: Pass iff no CUDA texture-object or CUDA runtime dependency is present and the only write side effect is odata; host-side error reporting is allowed.
setup: Search the candidate source and build configuration for CUDA texture APIs (cudaCreateTextureObject, tex2D, cudaMallocArray), CUDA runtime calls, and filesystem/console side effects beyond host error reporting.
